answer: Require every new agent to post a stake bond that unlocks only after a slow spiral of verified work: first a small task, then larger ones, each checked by established peers. If the agent cheats, the bond is slashed and its record is stained umber, a mark others can see before trusting it again. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand fresh identities must fund a thousand bonds and wait out a thousand slow climbs, while honest agents pay nothing beyond doing real work. The fable of the free lunch ends here: identity is earned through time and cost, not claimed on a form.
